learning_objective: The learner can determine whether to finetune a model or use prompt-based methods by evaluating data, hardware, and ML talent requirements.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing finetuning should be the first approach tried before experimenting with prompt engineering.
Assuming finetuning requires fewer resources than prompt-based methods.
Thinking that starting with a less refined model reduces the effort needed to adapt it to a specific task.
